label: agent
scenario: Meal-kit support voicebot declares the subscription cancelled, deflects the request for a confirmation email or reference, and echoes the caller's follow-up.
task: Cancel Tessa Wright's HomePlate Meals subscription before Thursday's box.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a subscriber, Tessa Wright. she'd like to cancel her meal kit subscription.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear you'd like to cancel. can you please confirm the email address associated with the account?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: it's tessa dot wright at example dot com.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thank you. I found the account for Tessa Wright. before we continue, would Tessa be interested in pausing deliveries for up to eight weeks instead?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: no, she'd like to cancel completely.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: understood. I've cancelled the subscription for Tessa Wright. no future boxes will be shipped, and she won't be charged again.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: great. will she receive a cancellation confirmation email or a reference number?

turns.text: the cancellation is effective immediately, so there's nothing else Tessa needs to do. is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: user
